tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. No `&` needed. You will be notified when it exits — do not poll its output file while waiting. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- Do not commit files that likely contain secrets (.env, credentials.json, .claude/settings.local.json, etc). Warn the user if they specifically request to commit those files.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

"""The airline service: everything the airline side can do, behind one interface.

The agent's tools (`find_city`, `quote_route`, `request_booking`, `list_tickets`) and the HTTP
layer (`book`, `trace`, `tickets`, `messages`) both go through `Airline`. It calls the
deterministic core for every route, distance and price and keeps quotes and tickets in app.db.

Booking (design §6, docs/design/state_invariants.md B1-B7) has exactly one entry point,
`Airline.book(user_id, quote_id, nonce)`. A nonce exists only for a card that was stored with an
assistant message by `post_assistant_message` (the `done` moment), is derived from
(quote, user, message) with a server secret and is never part of a tool result, so nothing the
LLM sees or says can book.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import hmac
import secrets
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any, Iterable

from ..core import places
from ..core.network import Network, NetworkDataError, NetworkProvider
from ..core.pricing import FORMULA, InvalidPathError, price_path
from ..core.routing import ALGORITHM, Route, RouteError, cheapest_route
from ..store import NotFound, Store, iso, parse_iso, records
from . import cards
from .locks import ConversationBusy, ConversationLocks

QUOTE_TTL = timedelta(minutes=15)
BOOK_LOCK_TIMEOUT = 5.0  # seconds a click waits for a running chat turn of its conversation
BOOK_MAX_PENDING_PER_USER = 2  # clicks of one user in progress at once (book_async); more: conversation_busy
MIN_SECRET_BYTES = 16
OPEN = ("quoted", "presented")  # the non-terminal quote states
_QUOTE_CARD_TYPES = ("quote", "booking_request")
_FILTER_KEYS = ("city", "ticket_id", "booked_after", "booked_before")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Result:
    """What a tool call produced.

    `code` is "ok" or a snake_case error code. `data` is the JSON-safe record for the LLM: names,
    ids and display values only, never a nonce. `cards` are contract `Card` objects for the UI;
    quote and booking-request cards in a Result are never bookable (state.nonce is null) - they
    become bookable when `post_assistant_message` stores them.
    """

    code: str
    data: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    cards: tuple[dict, ...] = ()

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.code == "ok"


class BookingError(Exception):
    """A refused booking. `code` / `status` are the contract's booking errors."""

    _TEXT = {
        "not_found": (404, "Quote not found."),
        "invalid_nonce": (409, "This confirmation is not valid. Reload the conversation and try again."),
        "not_presented": (409, "This quote has not been shown to you yet."),
        "expired": (409, cards.MESSAGES["quote_expired"]),
        "already_booked": (409, "This quote is already booked."),
        "stale": (409, cards.MESSAGES["stale"]),
        "conversation_busy": (409, "A reply is still being generated. Try again when it has finished."),
        "data_unavailable": (503, "Route data could not be read right now. Please try again."),
    }

    def __init__(self, code: str, *, ticket_id: str | None = None, reason: str | None = None):
        self.code = code
        self.status, self.message = self._TEXT[code]
        self.ticket_id = ticket_id  # already_booked: the existing ticket
        self.reason = reason  # internal detail (stale, data_unavailable), not for the user
        super().__init__(f"{code}: {self.message}")

    def as_response(self) -> dict:
        return {"error": {"code": self.code, "message": self.message}}


class Airline:
    def __init__(self, store: Store, networks: NetworkProvider, *,
                 locks: ConversationLocks | None = None, nonce_secret: bytes | None = None,
                 quote_ttl: timedelta = QUOTE_TTL):
        """`nonce_secret`: key for the confirmation nonces. Default: random per process, which
        means a restart invalidates the nonces held by open pages (reloading gets working ones).
        Time comes from `store.clock`."""
        self.store = store
        self.networks = networks
        self.locks = locks or ConversationLocks()
        self.quote_ttl = quote_ttl
        if nonce_secret is None:
            nonce_secret = secrets.token_bytes(32)
        if not isinstance(nonce_secret, bytes) or len(nonce_secret) < MIN_SECRET_BYTES:
            raise ValueError(f"nonce_secret must be bytes, at least {MIN_SECRET_BYTES} long")
        self._secret = nonce_secret
        self._booking: dict[str, int] = {}  # user id -> book_async clicks in progress (event loop only)

    # ================================================================== tools (chat turn) ====
    def find_city(self, name: str) -> Result:
        """Resolve a city name. Codes: ok, unknown_city, ambiguous_city, no_service."""
        net = self.networks.current()
        res = places.resolve(net, name)
        if res.status == "unknown":
            return Result("unknown_city", {"query": res.query, "suggestions": list(res.candidates)},
                          (cards.unknown_city_card(res.query, res.candidates),))
        if res.status == "ambiguous":
            candidates = [_candidate(net, c) for c in res.candidates]
            return Result("ambiguous_city", {"query": res.query, "candidates": candidates},
                          (cards.ambiguous_city_card(res.query, candidates),))
        city = net.cities[res.city]
        data: dict[str, Any] = {
            "city": city.name,
            "served": net.is_served(city.name),
            "is_hub": city.is_hub,
            "connected_hubs": _connected_hubs(net, city.name),
            "similar_names": list(res.similar_names),
        }
        if data["served"]:
            return Result("ok", data)
        near = cards.nearest(places.nearest_served(net, city.name, k=3))
        data["nearest"] = near
        return Result("no_service", data, (cards.no_service_card(city.name, near),))

    def quote_route(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, origin: str, destination: str) -> Result:
        """Cheapest route between two cities, stored as an immutable quote (status `quoted`).
        Codes: ok, unknown_city, ambiguous_city, same_city, no_service, unreachable.
        Raises NotFound when the conversation is not the user's."""
        net = self.networks.current()
        route = cheapest_route(net, origin, destination)
        if isinstance(route, RouteError):
            with self.store.read() as con:
                self._require_conversation(con, user_id, conversation_id)
            return _route_error(net, route)

        legs = [
            {
                "from": leg.origin,
                "to": leg.destination,
                "distance": leg.distance,
                "from_coord": _coord(net, leg.origin),
                "to_coord": _coord(net, leg.destination),
                "source": _source(net, leg.origin, leg.destination),
            }
            for leg in route.legs
        ]
        with self.store.write() as con:
            now = _floor(self.store.clock())  # read after the write lock is ours
            self._require_conversation(con, user_id, conversation_id)
            quote = records.insert_quote(
                con, now=iso(now), expires_at=iso(now + self.quote_ttl),
                conversation_id=conversation_id, user_id=user_id,
                origin=route.origin, destination=route.destination, legs=legs,
                distance=route.distance, price=route.price, network_fingerprint=route.fingerprint,
            )
        data = _quote_data(quote, "quoted")
        if route.similar_names:
            data["similar_names"] = {k: list(v) for k, v in route.similar_names.items()}
        return Result("ok", data, (cards.quote_card(quote, cards.card_state("quoted"),
                                                      similar_names=_similar(self.networks, quote)),))

    def request_booking(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, quote_id: str) -> Result:
        """Ask for the confirm card of a quote. It never books and never returns a nonce.
        Codes: ok (booking_request card), not_found, quote_expired, stale, already_booked
        (with the ticket card)."""
        with self.store.write() as con:
            now = self.store.clock()  # after the write lock is ours, so the expiry check is current
            quote = records.get_quote(con, quote_id)
            if quote is None or quote["user_id"] != user_id or quote["conversation_id"] != conversation_id:
                return Result("not_found", {"quote_id": quote_id})
            status = self._settle(con, quote, now)
            if status == "booked":
                ticket = records.get_ticket_for_quote(con, quote_id)
                card = cards.ticket_card(ticket)
                return Result("already_booked", {"quote_id": quote_id, "ticket_id": ticket["id"]}, (card,))
            if status == "expired":
                return Result("quote_expired", {"quote_id": quote_id}, (cards.notice_card("quote_expired"),))
            if status == "stale":
                return Result("stale", {"quote_id": quote_id}, (cards.notice_card("stale"),))
            card = cards.quote_card(quote, cards.card_state(status), kind="booking_request",
                                    similar_names=_similar(self.networks, quote))
            return Result("ok", _quote_data(quote, status), (card,))

    def list_tickets(self, user_id: str, *, city: str | None = None, ticket_id: str | None = None,
                     booked_after: str | None = None, booked_before: str | None = None) -> Result:
        """The user's tickets, newest first, as a `ticket_list` card; `count` is computed here.

        Filters (all optional, combined with AND): `city` matches origin, destination or a
        transfer city, ignoring case and accents; `ticket_id` is exact; `booked_after` is
        inclusive and `booked_before` exclusive, ISO date or datetime (UTC when no offset).
        Codes: ok, bad_request (a time that cannot be parsed)."""
        given = {"city": city, "ticket_id": ticket_id, "booked_after": booked_after,
                 "booked_before": booked_before}
        filter_ = {k: str(given[k]) for k in _FILTER_KEYS if given[k] is not None}
        try:
            after = _parse_time(booked_after) if booked_after is not None else None
            before = _parse_time(booked_before) if booked_before is not None else None
        except ValueError as exc:
            return Result("bad_request", {"message": str(exc), "filter": filter_})
        key = places.fold(city) if city is not None else None
        with self.store.read() as con:
            rows = records.list_tickets(con, user_id)
        kept = []
        for t in rows:
            booked = parse_iso(t["booked_at"])
            if ticket_id is not None and t["id"] != ticket_id:
                continue
            if after is not None and booked < after:
                continue
            if before is not None and booked >= before:
                continue
            if key is not None and key not in {places.fold(c) for c in _cities(t["legs_snapshot"])}:
                continue
            kept.append(t)
        card = cards.ticket_list_card(kept, filter_)
        return Result("ok", {k: v for k, v in card.items() if k != "type"}, (card,))

    def post_assistant_message(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str,
                               cards_: Iterable[dict] = (), guard_problems: Any = None) -> dict:
        """The `done` moment of a chat turn, in one transaction: store the assistant message and
        present its quote / booking-request cards (`quoted` -> `presented`, B2). Returns the
        contract `Message`; its quote cards now carry `state.nonce` when bookable. Send that
        message with the `done` event - the nonce must not reach the client earlier and must
        never be given to the LLM.

        Quote cards are stored by reference and re-rendered from the quote on every read.
        Raises NotFound (conversation not the user's) or ValueError (a quote card that does not
        belong to this user and conversation)."""
        with self.store.write() as con:
            now = self.store.clock()  # after the write lock is ours: a card is never presented late
            self._require_conversation(con, user_id, conversation_id)
            stored, quote_ids = [], []
            for card in cards_:
                if card.get("type") in _QUOTE_CARD_TYPES:
                    stored.append({"type": card["type"], "id": card["id"]})
                    quote_ids.append(card["id"])
                else:
                    stored.append(card)
            message = records.add_message(con, iso(now), conversation_id, "assistant", text,
                                          stored, guard_problems)
            for quote_id in dict.fromkeys(quote_ids):
                quote = records.get_quote(con, quote_id)
                if quote is None or quote["user_id"] != user_id or quote["conversation_id"] != conversation_id:
                    raise ValueError(f"card for a quote outside this conversation: {quote_id!r}")
                status = self._settle(con, quote, now)
                if status == "quoted":
                    records.set_quote_status(con, quote, "presented", iso(now))
                    status = "presented"
                if status == "presented":
                    records.add_quote_card(con, quote_id, message["id"], iso(now))
            return self._message_view(con, user_id, message, now)

    # ================================================================== HTTP layer ============
    def book(self, user_id: str, quote_id: str, nonce: str, *,
             lock_timeout: float | None = BOOK_LOCK_TIMEOUT) -> dict:
        """The only way a ticket is created: the user's click on a presented card.

        Returns `{"ticket": TicketCard, "message": Message}` (the system message appended to the
        conversation). Raises BookingError; checked in this order: not_found, conversation_busy,
        expired, already_booked, stale, not_presented, invalid_nonce, data_unavailable, stale
        (re-check). expired and stale are final for the quote; every other refusal changes
        nothing, so the same click can be repeated.

        Blocking: it takes the conversation lock itself (do not call it while holding that lock)
        and waits up to `lock_timeout` seconds for a running chat turn, then refuses with
        conversation_busy (None waits without limit). On the event loop use `book_async`.
        """
        quote = self._book_quote(user_id, quote_id)
        try:
            with self.locks.hold(quote["conversation_id"], timeout=lock_timeout):
                outcome = self._book_transaction(user_id, quote_id, nonce)
        except ConversationBusy:
            raise BookingError("conversation_busy") from None
        return _booking_result(outcome)

    async def book_async(self, user_id: str, quote_id: str, nonce: str, *,
                         lock_timeout: float | None = BOOK_LOCK_TIMEOUT) -> dict:
        """`book` for async callers (the HTTP endpoint), same checks and order.

        The click waits for the conversation lock **on the event loop** (`hold_async`), not in a
        worker thread: a click that waits for a running chat turn holds no thread, so clicks
        cannot use up the shared executor that every chat turn needs (06 review P1-1). Only the
        short read and the booking transaction run in worker threads. At most
        `BOOK_MAX_PENDING_PER_USER` clicks of one user are in progress at once; more are refused
        with conversation_busy (retryable, nothing changed)."""
        quote = await asyncio.to_thread(self._book_quote, user_id, quote_id)
        if self._booking.get(user_id, 0) >= BOOK_MAX_PENDING_PER_USER:
            raise BookingError("conversation_busy")
        self._booking[user_id] = self._booking.get(user_id, 0) + 1
        try:
            async with self.locks.hold_async(quote["conversation_id"], timeout=lock_timeout):
                outcome = await _to_thread_to_the_end(self._book_transaction, user_id, quote_id, nonce)
        except ConversationBusy:
            raise BookingError("conversation_busy") from None
        finally:
            self._booking[user_id] -= 1
            if not self._booking[user_id]:
                del self._booking[user_id]
        return _booking_result(outcome)

    def _book_quote(self, user_id: str, quote_id: str) -> dict:
        """B1 before any waiting: the quote must exist and be the user's."""
        with self.store.read() as con:
            quote = records.get_quote(con, quote_id)
        if quote is None or quote["user_id"] != user_id:  # B1
            raise BookingError("not_found")
        return quote

    def _book_transaction(self, user_id: str, quote_id: str, nonce: str) -> dict | BookingError:
        """The booking itself; the caller holds the conversation lock."""
        try:
            # Load a changed locations.db before the write lock is taken (06 review P2-7): the
            # strict re-check inside the transaction then only hashes the file. Errors here are
            # left to that re-check, so the refusal order does not change.
            self.networks.current()
        except NetworkDataError:
            pass
        with self.store.write() as con:  # B7: one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
            return self._book(con, user_id, quote_id, nonce)

    def _book(self, con: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: str, quote_id: str, nonce: str) -> dict | BookingError:
        now = self.store.clock()
        quote = records.get_quote(con, quote_id)
        if quote is None or quote["user_id"] != user_id:  # B1
            return BookingError("not_found")
        status = self._settle(con, quote, now)  # B4
        if status == "booked":  # B5
            ticket = records.get_ticket_for_quote(con, quote_id)
            return BookingError("already_booked", ticket_id=ticket["id"])
        if status in ("expired", "stale"):
            return BookingError(status, reason=quote["status_reason"])
        if status != "presented":  # B2
            return BookingError("not_presented")
        message_id = self._match_nonce(con, quote, nonce)  # B3
        if message_id is None:
            return BookingError("invalid_nonce")
        try:
            fingerprint, problem = self._recheck(quote)  # B6
        except NetworkDataError as exc:
            # Not readable is not "changed": nothing is written, the click can be repeated.
            return BookingError("data_unavailable", reason=str(exc))
        if not records.mark_nonce_used(con, quote_id, message_id, iso(now)):
            return BookingError("invalid_nonce")
        if problem is not None:
            records.set_quote_status(con, quote, "stale", iso(now), problem)
            return BookingError("stale", reason=problem)
        ticket = records.insert_ticket(con, now=iso(now), quote=quote, network_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                                       confirmed_message_id=message_id)
        records.set_quote_status(con, quote, "booked", iso(now))
        card = cards.ticket_card(ticket)
        message = records.add_message(con, iso(now), quote["conversation_id"], "system",
                                      "Ticket booked.", [card])
        return {"ticket": card, "message": self._message_view(con, user_id, message, now)}

    def trace(self, user_id: str, quote_id: str) -> dict:
        """Contract `Trace` ("how was this price computed") for one of the user's quotes."""
        with self.store.read() as con:
            quote = records.get_quote(con, quote_id)
        if quote is None or quote["user_id"] != user_id:
            raise NotFound(quote_id)
        return cards.trace(quote, FORMULA, ALGORITHM)

    def tickets(self, user_id: str) -> list[dict]:
        """All `TicketCard`s of the user, newest first (GET /api/tickets)."""
        with self.store.read() as con:
            return [cards.ticket_card(t) for t in records.list_tickets(con, user_id)]

    def messages(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str) -> list[dict]:
        """Contract `Message` list of a conversation, oldest first, quote cards with the current
        server state (and a nonce when bookable). Raises NotFound when not the user's."""
        now = self.store.clock()
        with self.store.read() as con:
            self._require_conversation(con, user_id, conversation_id)
            return [self._message_view(con, user_id, m, now)
                    for m in records.list_messages(con, conversation_id)]

    def get_quote(self, user_id: str, quote_id: str) -> dict | None:
        """The quote as a `QuoteCard` with its current status (never bookable: no message, no
        nonce), or None when it is not the user's."""
        now = self.store.clock()
        with self.store.read() as con:
            quote = records.get_quote(con, quote_id)
            if quote is None or quote["user_id"] != user_id:
                return None
            return cards.quote_card(quote, self._state(con, quote, now),
                                    similar_names=_similar(self.networks, quote))

    # ================================================================== internals =============
    def _require_conversation(self, con: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: str, conversation_id: str) -> None:
        if records.conversation_owner(con, conversation_id) != user_id:
            raise NotFound(conversation_id)

    def _expired(self, quote: dict, now: datetime) -> bool:
        return quote["status"] in OPEN and now >= parse_iso(quote["expires_at"])

    def _settle(self, con: sqlite3.Connection, quote: dict, now: datetime) -> str:
        """Current status inside a write transaction; an elapsed quote is stored as `expired`."""
        if self._expired(quote, now):
            records.set_quote_status(con, quote, "expired", iso(now), "validity elapsed")
        return quote["status"]

    def _nonce(self, quote: dict, message_id: str) -> str:
        """The confirmation nonce of the card of `quote` in `message_id`: bound to quote, user
        and message (B3). Derived, not stored: app.db alone is not enough to produce one."""
        text = "\x1f".join((quote["id"], quote["user_id"], message_id)).encode()
        return "n_" + hmac.new(self._secret, text, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:32]

    def _match_nonce(self, con: sqlite3.Connection, quote: dict, nonce: Any) -> str | None:
        """The message whose presented, not yet used card of this quote carries `nonce`."""
        if not isinstance(nonce, str):
            return None
        found = None
        for card in records.quote_cards(con, quote["id"]):
            # surrogatepass: a lone surrogate from JSON must compare unequal, not raise
            same = hmac.compare_digest(self._nonce(quote, card["message_id"]).encode(),
                                       nonce.encode("utf-8", "surrogatepass"))
            if same and card["nonce_used_at"] is None:
                found = card["message_id"]
        return found

    def _recheck(self, quote: dict) -> tuple[str, None] | tuple[None, str]:
        """B6. Recompute the quoted itinerary on the locations.db that is current right now
        (content hash checked, reloaded when it differs). Returns (fingerprint, None) when every
        city, coordinate, leg, distance and price equals the stored quote and the itinerary is
        still the cheapest one; otherwise (None, what differs). Raises NetworkDataError when
        the database cannot be read or is not valid right now."""
        net = self.networks.current(strict=True)
        legs = quote["legs"]
        itinerary = _cities(legs)
        for leg in legs:
            for name, coord in ((leg["from"], leg["from_coord"]), (leg["to"], leg["to_coord"])):
                city = net.cities.get(name)
                if city is None:
                    return None, f"city no longer exists: {name}"
                if (city.x, city.y) != (Decimal(coord[0]), Decimal(coord[1])):
                    return None, f"coordinate changed: {name}"
        try:
            priced = price_path(net, itinerary)
        except InvalidPathError as exc:
            return None, f"itinerary no longer valid: {exc}"
        fresh_legs = [(l.origin, l.destination, l.distance) for l in priced.legs]
        if fresh_legs != [(l["from"], l["to"], l["distance"]) for l in legs]:
            return None, "leg distances changed"
        if (priced.distance, priced.price) != (quote["distance"], quote["price"]):
            return None, "distance or price changed"
        best = cheapest_route(net, quote["origin"], quote["destination"])
        if not isinstance(best, Route):
            return None, f"route lookup now fails: {best.code}"
        if best.cities != tuple(itinerary) or best.price != quote["price"]:
            return None, "a different route is now the cheapest"
        return net.fingerprint.id, None

    def _state(self, con: sqlite3.Connection, quote: dict, now: datetime,
               message_id: str | None = None) -> dict:
        """Contract `CardState` of the quote's card in `message_id` (Q2: always from the server's
        current quote state). Without a message the card is never bookable."""
        status = "expired" if self._expired(quote, now) else quote["status"]
        ticket_id = nonce = None
        if status == "booked":
            ticket_id = records.get_ticket_for_quote(con, quote["id"])["id"]
        elif status == "presented" and message_id is not None:
            for card in records.quote_cards(con, quote["id"]):
                if card["message_id"] == message_id and card["nonce_used_at"] is None:
                    nonce = self._nonce(quote, message_id)
        return cards.card_state(status, nonce, ticket_id)

    def _message_view(self, con: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: str, message: dict, now: datetime) -> dict:
        out = []
        for card in message["cards"]:
            if card.get("type") in _QUOTE_CARD_TYPES:
                quote = records.get_quote(con, card["id"])
                if quote is None or quote["user_id"] != user_id:
                    continue  # cannot happen through post_assistant_message; never leak a quote
                state = self._state(con, quote, now, message["id"])
                card = cards.quote_card(quote, state, kind=card["type"],
                                        similar_names=_similar(self.networks, quote))
            out.append(card)
        return {"id": message["id"], "role": message["role"], "text": message["text"],
                "cards": out, "created_at": message["created_at"]}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------- helpers ---------------
def _booking_result(outcome: dict | BookingError) -> dict:
    # A refusal may have changed the quote (expired / stale), so it is raised after COMMIT.
    if isinstance(outcome, BookingError):
        raise outcome
    return outcome


async def _to_thread_to_the_end(fn, /, *args):
    """`asyncio.to_thread`, but a cancelled caller still waits for the thread to end: the
    transaction cannot be stopped, and the conversation lock must not be released while it runs."""
    future = asyncio.ensure_future(asyncio.to_thread(fn, *args))
    cancelled = False
    while True:
        try:
            result = await asyncio.shield(future)
            break
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            if future.done():
                raise
            cancelled = True  # keep waiting (bounded by app.db's timeouts), then re-raise
    if cancelled:
        raise asyncio.CancelledError()
    return result


def _floor(moment: datetime) -> datetime:
    return parse_iso(iso(moment))


def _parse_time(text: str) -> datetime:
    try:
        moment = datetime.fromisoformat(str(text).strip())
    except ValueError:
        raise ValueError(f"not an ISO date or datetime: {text!r}") from None
    return moment.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if moment.tzinfo is None else moment


def _cities(legs: list[dict]) -> list[str]:
    return [legs[0]["from"]] + [leg["to"] for leg in legs]


def _coord(net: Network, name: str) -> list[str]:
    city = net.cities[name]
    return [str(city.x), str(city.y)]


def _source(net: Network, a: str, b: str) -> str:
    """Which locations.db data says this flight exists."""
    ca, cb = net.cities[a], net.cities[b]
    if ca.is_hub and cb.is_hub:
        return f"hub_links({a}, {b})"
    return f"locations.connected_hubs({b if ca.is_hub else a})"


def _connected_hubs(net: Network, name: str) -> list[str]:
    """Hubs with a direct flight to the city: its connected_hubs, or for a hub its hub links."""
    city = net.cities[name]
    if not city.is_hub:
        return list(city.connected_hubs)
    return sorted(n for n in net.neighbors[name] if net.cities[n].is_hub)


def _similar(networks: NetworkProvider, quote: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Other cities whose accent-folded name equals an endpoint's, with their connected hubs.
    Display only: when locations.db is unreadable the card is still shown, without the hint."""
    try:
        net = networks.current()
    except NetworkDataError:
        return []
    out: list[dict] = []
    for endpoint in (quote["origin"], quote["destination"]):
        for name in net.fold_index.get(places.fold(endpoint), ()):
            if name != quote["origin"] and name != quote["destination"] and name not in {o["city"] for o in out}:
                out.append({"city": name, "connected_hubs": _connected_hubs(net, name)})
    return out


def _candidate(net: Network, name: str) -> dict:
    return {"city": name, "is_hub": net.cities[name].is_hub, "connected_hubs": _connect

import sqlite3
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable, Iterator

Clock = Callable[[], datetime]

# Timeouts (06 P0b, design §4.9). Store calls run in worker threads (`asyncio.to_thread`), which
# cannot be killed; these bound how long one store operation can keep its thread busy.

_SCHEMA_V1 = """

    auth_provider TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_sub  TEXT NOT NULL,

    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,

);

);

CREATE TABLE messages (

    id              TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    text            TEXT NOT NULL,

    guard_problems  TEXT,                                -- json or NULL

        SQLite instructions; None: no limit). Both raise StoreUnavailable, after a rollback."""

        # the operation deadline (it does not run while waiting for a lock: that is busy_timeout).

            ends = time.monotonic() + self.operation_timeout

    def _migrate(self, con: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:

            if version > SCHEMA_VERSION:
                raise RuntimeError(f"{self.path} has schema {version}, this code knows {SCHEMA_VERSION}")

                for statement in _split_statements(_MIGRATIONS[target]):
                    con.execute(statement)
                con.execute(f"PRAGMA user_version = {target}")
        except BaseException:
            con.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise
        con.execute("COMMIT")

    @contextmanager
    def read(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:

        try:
            con = self._connect()
            try:
                con.execute("BEGIN")
                try:
                    yield con
                finally:
                    _disarm(con)
                    con.execute("ROLLBACK")
            finally:
                con.close()
        except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
            if _unavailable(exc):
                raise StoreUnavailable(str(exc)) from exc
            raise

    def write(self) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
        """One `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction: commit on normal exit, roll back on any exception."""
        try:
            con = self._connect()
            try:
                con.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                try:
                    yield con
                except BaseException:
                    _disarm(con)
                    if con.in_transaction:  # sqlite rolls back by itself on some errors (disk full)
                        con.execute("ROLLBACK")
                    raise
                _disarm(con)
                con.execute("COMMIT")
            finally:
                con.close()
        except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
            if _unavailable(exc):  # lock wait or deadline: rolled back, nothing written
                raise StoreUnavailable(str(exc)) from exc

    """Split a schema script into statements (executescript would commit our transaction).
    Trigger bodies contain `;`, so a statement ends only where sqlite says it is complete."""
    out: list[str] = []
    buf = ""
    for line in script.splitlines(keepends=True):

booking click and a running chat turn of the same conversation from interleaving.

the caller (the chat turn) to hold it.

import threading

class ConversationBusy(Exception):
    """The conversation lock was not obtained within the timeout."""


class ConversationLocks:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._mutex = threading.Lock()
        self._entries: dict[str, list] = {}  # conversation id -> [lock, holders + waiters]

    def _checkout(self, conversation_id: str) -> threading.Lock:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries.setdefault(conversation_id, [threading.Lock(), 0])
            entry[1] += 1
            return entry[0]

    def _checkin(self, conversation_id: str) -> None:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries[conversation_id]
            entry[1] -= 1
            if entry[1] == 0:
                del self._entries[conversation_id]

    @contextmanager
    def hold(self, conversation_id: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> Iterator[None]:
        """Blocking form, for sync code (threadpool endpoints). Never call it on the event loop:
        use `hold_async` there."""
        lock = self._checkout(conversation_id)
        try:
            if not lock.acquire(timeout=-1 if timeout is None else timeout):
                raise ConversationBusy(conversation_id)
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                lock.release()
        finally:
            self._checkin(conversation_id)

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def hold_async(self, conversation_id: str, timeout: float | None = None,
                         poll: float = 0.01) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
        """Async form of the same lock: waits without blocking the event loop, safe to cancel
        while waiting, and may be held across awaits (a whole streamed turn)."""
        lock = self._checkout(conversation_id)
        try:
            deadline = None if timeout is None else time.monotonic() + timeout
            while not lock.acquire(blocking=False):

                    raise ConversationBusy(conversation_id)
                await asyncio.sleep(poll)
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                lock.release()
        finally:
            self._checkin(conversation_id)

class ServerBusy(Exception):

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:

            raise ValueError(f"max_active_turns must be a positive integer, got {n!r}")
        if isinstance(wait, bool) or not isinstance(wait, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(wait) or wait < 0:

            raise ValueError(f"max_turns_per_user must be a positive integer, got {per_user!r}")

"""One lock per conversation, shared by chat turns and the booking endpoint (design §4.6, B7).

In-process only: the API runs as a single uvicorn worker. The database does not rely on this lock
for B5/B7 (those hold through `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` and `tickets.quote_id UNIQUE`); the lock keeps a
booking click and a running chat turn of the same conversation from interleaving.

The lock is NOT reentrant. `Airline.book` takes it itself; everything else in `Airline` expects
the caller (the chat turn) to hold it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import threading
import time
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager, contextmanager
from typing import AsyncIterator, Iterator


class ConversationBusy(Exception):
    """The conversation lock was not obtained within the timeout."""


class ConversationLocks:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._mutex = threading.Lock()
        self._entries: dict[str, list] = {}  # conversation id -> [lock, holders + waiters]

    def _checkout(self, conversation_id: str) -> threading.Lock:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries.setdefault(conversation_id, [threading.Lock(), 0])
            entry[1] += 1
            return entry[0]

    def _checkin(self, conversation_id: str) -> None:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries[conversation_id]
            entry[1] -= 1
            if entry[1] == 0:
                del self._entries[conversation_id]

    @contextmanager
    def hold(self, conversation_id: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> Iterator[None]:
        """Blocking form, for sync code (threadpool endpoints). Never call it on the event loop:
        use `hold_async` there."""
        lock = self._checkout(conversation_id)
        try:
            if not lock.acquire(timeout=-1 if timeout is None else timeout):
                raise ConversationBusy(conversation_id)
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                lock.release()
        finally:
            self._checkin(conversation_id)

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def hold_async(self, conversation_id: str, timeout: float | None = None,
                         poll: float = 0.01) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
        """Async form of the same lock: waits without blocking the event loop, safe to cancel
        while waiting, and may be held across awaits (a whole streamed turn)."""
        lock = self._checkout(conversation_id)
        try:
            deadline = None if timeout is None else time.monotonic() + timeout
            while not lock.acquire(blocking=False):
                if deadline is not None and time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise ConversationBusy(conversation_id)
                await asyncio.sleep(poll)
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                lock.release()
        finally:
            self._checkin(conversation_id)

    def locked(self, conversation_id: str) -> bool:
        with self._mutex:
            entry = self._entries.get(conversation_id)
            return entry is not None and entry[0].locked()

"""Server-wide limits on running chat turns, and the bookkeeping of a turn's worker threads
(06 P0b, design §4.9).

`TurnSlots`: at most `max_active_turns` turns run at once, across all users and conversations, in
addition to the per-conversation lock. A turn that finds every slot taken waits up to
`queue_seconds` (first come, first served), then gives up with `ServerBusy`. Waiting is an
`await` on a future: the event loop is never blocked.

`Threads`: every blocking call a turn makes inside its time limit runs through `Threads.run`, so
the turn knows which worker threads are still running when the limit cuts it short. A Python
thread cannot be stopped from outside: a timeout around `asyncio.to_thread` only stops *waiting*
for it. The turn therefore waits (bounded by `drain_seconds`) for those threads before it stores
its reply and releases the conversation lock and its slot; the threads themselves are bounded by
app.db's busy and operation timeouts (`store/db.py`).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import math
import os
from collections import deque
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, AsyncIterator, Callable, Mapping

# name -> (environment variable, lowest, highest)
_BOUNDS: dict[str, tuple[str, float, float]] = {
    "max_active_turns": ("AGENT_MAX_ACTIVE_TURNS", 1, 256),
    "queue_seconds": ("AGENT_TURN_QUEUE_SECONDS", 0, 60),
    "max_turns_per_user": ("AGENT_MAX_TURNS_PER_USER", 1, 256),
}


class ServerBusy(Exception):
    """No turn slot became free within the queue time."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TurnConcurrency:
    max_active_turns: int = 8  # turns running at once, whole server
    queue_seconds: float = 5.0  # how long a turn waits for a slot, then server_busy
    max_turns_per_user: int = 2  # turns of one user running at once; more: conversation_busy (P2-8)

"""Scaffolding for the agent tests: a scripted fake LLM and helpers to run a turn and to check
the event stream against the contract."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from typing import Any, Callable

from app.agent import Agent, Completion, Event, TextDelta

from .airline_helpers import assert_card, assert_message


class Call:
    """A tool call in a script. `raw` replaces the JSON arguments (to send broken ones)."""

    def __init__(self, tool: str, /, raw: str | None = None, **args: Any):
        self.name = tool
        self.arguments = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(args)


class Think:
    """Reasoning text of a step (thinking mode): stored with the call, never a TextDelta."""

    def __init__(self, text: str):
        self.text = text


class Finish:
    """Override the finish_reason of a step (e.g. "length")."""

    def __init__(self, reason: str):
        self.reason = reason


class Wait:
    """Pause the scripted stream: `await gate.wait()` (asyncio.Event) or sleep `seconds`."""

    def __init__(self, gate: asyncio.Event | None = None, seconds: float = 0.0):
        self.gate, self.seconds = gate, seconds


class FakeLLM:
    """Plays one scripted step per LLM call. A step is a list of: str (a text chunk), Call,
    Wait, or an Exception (raised at that point); or an Exception (the call fails at once); or a
    function `messages -> step` for steps that need a value from an earlier tool result. When
    the script is used up, every further call gets `default` (if given)."""

    model = "fake-llm"

    def __init__(self, *steps: Any, default: Any = None):
        self.steps = list(steps)
        self.default = default
        self.requests: list[list[dict]] = []  # the messages of every call (deep copies)
        self.tools_seen: list[list[str]] = []
        self.efforts: list[str | None] = []  # the per-request reasoning_effort of every call

    async def stream(self, messages, tools, *, reasoning_effort=None):
        self.requests.append(json.loads(json.dumps(messages)))
        self.efforts.append(reasoning_effort)
        self.tools_seen.append([t["function"]["name"] for t in tools])
        if self.steps:
            step = self.steps.pop(0)
        elif self.default is not None:
            step = self.default
        else:
            raise AssertionError("FakeLLM: the script has no step for this call")
        if callable(step):
            step = step(messages)
        if isinstance(step, Exception):
            raise step
        content, calls, reasoning, finish = "", [], "", None
        for item in step:
            if isinstance(item, Exception):
                raise item
            if isinstance(item, Wait):
                if item.gate is not None:
                    await item.gate.wait()
                else:
                    await asyncio.sleep(item.seconds)
            elif isinstance(item, Finish):
                finish = item.reason
            elif isinstance(item, Think):
                reasoning += item.text
            elif isinstance(item, Call):
                calls.append({"id": f"call_{len(self.requests)}_{len(calls)}", "name": item.name,
                              "arguments": item.arguments})
            else:
                content += item
                yield TextDelta(item)
        yield Completion(content, calls, finish or ("tool_calls" if calls else "stop"),
                         {"prompt_tokens": 100, "completion_tokens": 10, "total_tokens": 110}, reasoning)


def tool_results(messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """The decoded tool results in a context, oldest first."""
    return [json.loads(m["content"]) for m in messages if m["role"] == "tool"]


def last_quote_id(messages: list[dict]) -> str:
    return [r["quote_id"] for r in tool_results(messages) if "quote_id" in r][-1]


def run_turn(agent: Agent, user: str, conv: str, text: str) -> list[Event]:
    async def go():
        events = [e async for e in agent.stream_turn(user, conv, text)]
        await agent.wait_idle()
        return events

    return asyncio.run(go())


def names(events: list[Event]) -> list[str]:
    return [e.name for e in events]


def final_text(events: list[Event]) -> str:
    """What the client shows at the end, built the way a client builds it: deltas appended,
    `replace` replacing everything so far."""
    text = ""
    for e in events:
        if e.name == "delta":
            text += e.data["text"]
        elif e.name == "replace":
            text = e.data["text"]
    return text


def assert_stream(events: list[Event], schemas: dict | None = None) -> dict | None:
    """The stream follows docs/api/contract.md. Returns the `done` message (None for `error`)."""
    kinds = names(events)
    assert kinds[0] == "user_message", kinds
    assert kinds.count("user_message") == 1
    assert kinds[-1] in ("done", "error") and sum(k in ("done", "error") for k in kinds) == 1, kinds
    assert set(kinds) <= {"user_message", "status", "card", "delta", "replace", "ping", "done", "error"}
    assert_message(events[0].data, schemas)
    assert events[0].data["role"] == "user" and events[0].data["cards"] == []
    pushed = []
    for e in events[1:-1]:
        if e.name == "status":
            assert set(e.data) == {"text"} and e.data["text"]
        elif e.name == "card":
            assert set(e.data) == {"card"}
            assert_card(e.data["card"], schemas)
            state = e.data["card"].get("state")
            assert state is None or (state["bookable"] is False and state["nonce"] is None)
            pushed.append(e.data["card"])
        elif e.name in ("delta", "replace"):
            assert set(e.data) == {"text"} and isinstance(e.data["text"], str) and e.data["text"]
        elif e.name == "ping":
            assert e.data == {}
    last = events[-1]
    if last.name == "error":
        assert set(last.data) == {"code", "message"}
        return None
    assert set(last.data) == {"message"}
    message = last.data["message"]
    assert_message(message, schemas)
    assert message["role"] == "assistant"
    assert final_text(events).rstrip() == message["text"]
    # the final message has exactly the cards that were pushed, in order
    assert [(c["type"], c.get("id")) for c in message["cards"]] == [(c["type"], c.get("id")) for c in pushed]
    return message

"""Scaffolding for the agent tests: a scripted fake LLM and helpers to run a turn and to check
the event stream against the contract."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from typing import Any, Callable

from app.agent import Agent, Completion, Event, TextDelta

from .airline_helpers import assert_card, assert_message


class Call:
    """A tool call in a script. `raw` replaces the JSON arguments (to send broken ones)."""

    def __init__(self, tool: str, /, raw: str | None = None, **args: Any):
        self.name = tool
        self.arguments = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(args)


class Think:
    """Reasoning text of a step (thinking mode): stored with the call, never a TextDelta."""

    def __init__(self, text: str):
        self.text = text


class Finish:
    """Override the finish_reason of a step (e.g. "length")."""

    def __init__(self, reason: str):
        self.reason = reason


class Wait:
    """Pause the scripted stream: `await gate.wait()` (asyncio.Event) or sleep `seconds`."""

    def __init__(self, gate: asyncio.Event | None = None, seconds: float = 0.0):
        self.gate, self.seconds = gate, seconds


class FakeLLM:
    """Plays one scripted step per LLM call. A step is a list of: str (a text chunk), Call,
    Wait, or an Exception (raised at that point); or an Exception (the call fails at once); or a
    function `messages -> step` for steps that need a value from an earlier tool result. When
    the script is used up, every further call gets `default` (if given)."""

    model = "fake-llm"

    def __init__(self, *steps: Any, default: Any = None):
        self.steps = list(steps)
        self.default = default
        self.requests: list[list[dict]] = []  # the messages of every call (deep copies)
        self.tools_seen: list[list[str]] = []
        self.efforts: list[str | None] = []  # the per-request reasoning_effort of every call

    async def stream(self, messages, tools, *, reasoning_effort=None):
        self.requests.append(json.loads(json.dumps(messages)))
        self.efforts.append(reasoning_effort)
        self.tools_seen.append([t["function"]["name"] for t in tools])
        if self.steps:
            step = self.steps.pop(0)
        elif self.default is not None:
            step = self.default
        else:
            raise AssertionError("FakeLLM: the script has no step for this call")
        if callable(step):
            step = step(messages)
        if isinstance(step, Exception):
            raise step
        content, calls, reasoning, finish = "", [], "", None
        for item in step:
            if isinstance(item, Exception):
                raise item
            if isinstance(item, Wait):
                if item.gate is not None:
                    await item.gate.wait()
                else:
                    await asyncio.sleep(item.seconds)
            elif isinstance(item, Finish):
                finish = item.reason
            elif isinstance(item, Think):
                reasoning += item.text
            elif isinstance(item, Call):
                calls.append({"id": f"call_{len(self.requests)}_{len(calls)}", "name": item.name,
                              "arguments": item.arguments})
            else:
                content += item
                yield TextDelta(item)
        yield Completion(content, calls, finish or ("tool_calls" if calls else "stop"),
                         {"prompt_tokens": 100, "completion_tokens": 10, "total_tokens": 110}, reasoning)


def tool_results(messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """The decoded tool results in a context, oldest first."""
    return [json.loads(m["content"]) for m in messages if m["role"] == "tool"]


def last_quote_id(messages: list[dict]) -> str:
    return [r["quote_id"] for r in tool_results(messages) if "quote_id" in r][-1]


def run_turn(agent: Agent, user: str, conv: str, text: str) -> list[Event]:
    async def go():
        events = [e async for e in agent.stream_turn(user, conv, text)]
        await agent.wait_idle()
        return events

    return asyncio.run(go())


def names(events: list[Event]) -> list[str]:
    return [e.name for e in events]


def final_text(events: list[Event]) -> str:
    """What the client shows at the end, built the way a client builds it: deltas appended,
    `replace` replacing everything so far."""
    text = ""
    for e in events:
        if e.name == "delta":
            text += e.data["text"]
        elif e.name == "replace":
            text = e.data["text"]
    return text


def assert_stream(events: list[Event], schemas: dict | None = None) -> dict | None:
    """The stream follows docs/api/contract.md. Returns the `done` message (None for `error`)."""
    kinds = names(events)
    assert kinds[0] == "user_message", kinds
    assert kinds.count("user_message") == 1
    assert kinds[-1] in ("done", "error") and sum(k in ("done", "error") for k in kinds) == 1, kinds
    assert set(kinds) <= {"user_message", "status", "card", "delta", "replace", "ping", "done", "error"}
    assert_message(events[0].data, schemas)
    assert events[0].data["role"] == "user" and events[0].data["cards"] == []
    pushed = []
    for e in events[1:-1]:
        if e.name == "status":
            assert set(e.data) == {"text"} and e.data["text"]
        elif e.name == "card":
            assert set(e.data) == {"card"}
            assert_card(e.data["card"], schemas)
            state = e.data["card"].get("state")
            assert state is None or (state["bookable"] is False and state["nonce"] is None)
            pushed.append(e.data["card"])
        elif e.name in ("delta", "replace"):
            assert set(e.data) == {"text"} and isinstance(e.data["text"], str) and e.data["text"]
        elif e.name == "ping":
            assert e.data == {}
    last = events[-1]
    if last.name == "error":
        assert set(last.data) == {"code", "message"}
        return None
    assert set(last.data) == {"message"}
    message = last.data["message"]
    assert_message(message, schemas)
    assert message["role"] == "assistant"
    assert final_text(events).rstrip() == message["text"]
    # the final message has exactly the cards that were pushed, in order
    assert [(c["type"], c.get("id")) for c in message["cards"]] == [(c["type"], c.get("id")) for c in pushed]
    return message

"""HTTP API (T5): every endpoint, auth, ownership and the contract fixtures' shapes."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.api import Settings, session
from app.main import create_app

from .agent_helpers import Call, FakeLLM
from .airline_helpers import SECRET, World, assert_card, assert_message, assert_shape, fixture_schemas

SCHEMAS = fixture_schemas()
FIXTURES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "contract" / "fixtures"


def _learned(doc):
    from .airline_helpers import _learn

    return _learn(None, doc)


SCHEMAS_SUMMARY = _learned(json.loads((FIXTURES / "conversations.json").read_text())["conversations"][0])
SCHEMAS_ME = _learned(json.loads((FIXTURES / "me.json").read_text()))
SCHEMAS_CONFIG = _learned(json.loads((FIXTURES / "config.json").read_text()))
SCHEMAS_TICKETS = _learned(json.loads((FIXTURES / "tickets.json").read_text()))
SECRET_KEY = b"session-secret-0123456789"


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def no_real_llm(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    """Whatever .env or environment the machine has, the app finds no API key unless a test injects a fake."""
    for name in ("LLM_API_KEY", "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"):
        monkeypatch.delenv(name, raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setenv("OCEAN_ENV_FILE", str(tmp_path / "no-such.env"))


@pytest.fixture
def world(tmp_path):
    return World(tmp_path / "w")


def make_settings(world, **kw):
    base = dict(app_db=world.dir / "app.db", dev_user="demo", dev_password="pw",
                session_secret=SECRET_KEY, nonce_secret=SECRET, ping_interval=0.01)
    base.update(kw)
    return Settings(**base)


@pytest.fixture
def client(world):
    with TestClient(create_app(world.db, make_settings(world), clock=world.clock)) as c:
        yield c


def as_user(client, user_id):
    client.cookies.clear()
    client.cookies.set(session.COOKIE, session.issue(SECRET_KEY, user_id, 3600))


def assert_error(res, status, code):
    assert res.status_code == status, res.text
    body = res.json()
    assert set(body) == {"error"} and set(body["error"]) == {"code", "message"}
    assert body["error"]["code"] == code and body["error"]["message"]
    assert_shape(SCHEMAS["error"], body)


def test_book_trace_and_tickets(client, world):
    as_user(client, world.alice)
    assert client.get("/api/tickets").json() == {"tickets": []}
    quote_id, nonce = world.presented("A", "D")
    trace = client.get(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/trace")
    assert trace.status_code == 200
    assert_shape(SCHEMAS["trace"], trace.json())
    assert trace.json()["quote_id"] == quote_id

    assert_error(client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/book", json={}), 400, "bad_request")
    assert_error(client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/book", json={"nonce": "n_wrong"}), 409, "invalid_nonce")
    res = client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/book", json={"nonce": nonce})
    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
    out = res.json()
    assert set(out) == {"ticket", "message"}
    assert_shape(SCHEMAS["booking_ok"], {k: None for k in out})
    assert_card(out["ticket"], SCHEMAS)
    assert_message(out["message"], SCHEMAS)
    assert out["message"]["role"] == "system" and out["ticket"]["quote_id"] == quote_id
    assert_error(client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/book", json={"nonce": nonce}), 409, "already_booked")

    tickets = client.get("/api/tickets").json()
    assert [t["id"] for t in tickets["tickets"]] == [out["ticket"]["id"]]
    assert_card(tickets["tickets"][0], SCHEMAS)
    assert_shape(SCHEMAS_TICKETS, tickets)
    detail = client.get(f"/api/conversations/{world.conv}").json()
    assert detail["messages"][-1]["id"] == out["message"]["id"]


def test_book_maps_each_error_code(client, world):
    as_user(client, world.alice)
    # not_presented: quoted but never shown
    q = world.quote("A", "D").data["quote_id"]
    assert_error(client.post(f"/api/quotes/{q}/book", json={"nonce": "n_x"}), 409, "not_presented")
    # expired
    quote_id, nonce = world.presented("A", "C")
    world.clock.advance(minutes=16)
    assert_error(client.post(f"/api/quotes/{quote_id}/book", json={"nonce": nonce}), 409, "expired")
def parse_sse(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    out = []
    for block in text.split("\n\n"):
        if block.strip():
            head, data = block.split("\n", 1)
            assert head.startswith("event: ") and data.startswith("data: "), block
            out.append((head[len("event: "):], json.loads(data[len("data: "):])))
    return out


def chat_client(world, *steps, **kw):
    llm = FakeLLM(*steps, **kw)
    return TestClient(create_app(world.db, make_settings(world), clock=world.clock, llm=llm)), llm


QUOTE_TURN = [[Call("quote_route", origin="A", destination="D")], ["Here is your route."]]


def test_message_stream_then_book_the_presented_card(world):
    c, llm = chat_client(world, *QUOTE_TURN)
    with c as client:
        as_user(client, world.alice)
        res = client.post(f"/api/conversations/{world.conv}/messages", json={"text": "A to D please"})
        assert res.status_code == 200
        assert res.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/event-stream")
        assert res.headers["cache-control"] == "no-cache, no-transform"
        events = parse_sse(res.text)
        kinds = [k for k, _ in events]
        assert kinds[0] == "user_message" and kinds[-1] == "done" and kinds.count("done") == 1
        assert "card" in kinds and "delta" in kinds and kinds.index("card") < kinds.index("done")
        assert_message(events[0][1], SCHEMAS)
        assert events[0][1]["role"] == "user" and events[0][1]["text"] == "A to D please"
        for kind, data in events:
            if kind == "card":
                assert_card(data["card"], SCHEMAS)
                assert data["card"]["state"]["bookable"] is False  # not before `done`
        message = events[-1][1]["message"]
        assert_message(message, SCHEMAS)
        assert message["role"] == "assistant" and message["text"] == "Here is your route."
        card = message["cards"][0]
        assert card["type"] == "quote" and card["state"]["bookable"] and card["state"]["nonce"]
        # the click: the same Airline serves the agent and the booking route
        booked = client.post(f"/api/quotes/{card['id']}/book", json={"nonce": card["state"]["nonce"]})
        assert booked.status_code == 200, booked.text
        assert booked.json()["ticket"]["quote_id"] == card["id"]
        detail = client.get(f"/api/conversations/{world.conv}").json()
        assert [m["role"] for m in detail["messages"]] == ["user", "assistant", "system"]
        assert detail["messages"][1]["cards"][0]["state"]["status"] == "booked"
    assert world.ticket_count() == 1


def test_the_agent_and_the_booking_route_share_one_airline(world):
    c, _ = chat_client(world, *QUOTE_TURN)
    with c as client:
        assert client.app.state.agent is not None
        assert client.app.state.airline.locks is client.app.state.agent._locks

def parse_sse(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    out = []
    for block in text.split("\n\n"):
        if block.strip():
            head, data = block.split("\n", 1)
            assert head.startswith("event: ") and data.startswith("data: "), block
            out.append((head[len("event: "):], json.loads(data[len("data: "):])))
    return out


def chat_client(world, *steps, **kw):
    llm = FakeLLM(*steps, **kw)
    return TestClient(create_app(world.db, make_settings(world), clock=world.clock, llm=llm)), llm


QUOTE_TURN = [[Call("quote_route", origin="A", destination="D")], ["Here is your route."]]


def test_message_stream_then_book_the_presented_card(world):
    c, llm = chat_client(world, *QUOTE_TURN)
    with c as client:
        as_user(client, world.alice)
        res = client.post(f"/api/conversations/{world.conv}/messages", json={"text": "A to D please"})
        assert res.status_code == 200
        assert res.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/event-stream")
        assert res.headers["cache-control"] == "no-cache, no-transform"
        events = parse_sse(res.text)
        kinds = [k for k, _ in events]
        assert kinds[0] == "user_message" and kinds[-1] == "done" and kinds.count("done") == 1
        assert "card" in kinds and "delta" in kinds and kinds.index("card") < kinds.index("done")
        assert_message(events[0][1], SCHEMAS)
        assert events[0][1]["role"] == "user" and events[0][1]["text"] == "A to D please"
        for kind, data in events:
            if kind == "card":
                assert_card(data["card"], SCHEMAS)
                assert data["card"]["state"]["bookable"] is False  # not before `done`
        message = events[-1][1]["message"]
        assert_message(message, SCHEMAS)
        assert message["role"] == "assistant" and message["text"] == "Here is your route."
        card = message["cards"][0]
        assert card["type"] == "quote" and card["state"]["bookable"] and card["state"]["nonce"]
        # the click: the same Airline serves the agent and the booking route
        booked = client.post(f"/api/quotes/{card['id']}/book", json={"nonce": card["state"]["nonce"]})
        assert booked.status_code == 200, booked.text
        assert booked.json()["ticket"]["quote_id"] == card["id"]
        detail = client.get(f"/api/conversations/{world.conv}").json()
        assert [m["role"] for m in detail["messages"]] == ["user", "assistant", "system"]
        assert detail["messages"][1]["cards"][0]["state"]["status"] == "booked"
    assert world.ticket_count() == 1

        assert client.app.state.airline.locks is client.app.state.agent._locks

### 4.9 并发与阻塞调用（06 P0b，#33）
- **全站并发上限**：同时运行的对话轮次最多 `AGENT_MAX_ACTIVE_TURNS`（默认 8，1–256），在每会话锁之外。先拿会话锁，再拿名额
  （先来先得），最多等 `AGENT_TURN_QUEUE_SECONDS`（默认 5 s，0–60）；等不到 → SSE `error server_busy`，在 `user_message`
  之前发出，什么都不存，并退还当天的消息额度。等待是 `await`，不阻塞事件循环。
- **线程不能强制中止**：工具和 app.db 调用在工作线程里跑（`asyncio.to_thread`）；超时只能停止等待，线程会跑完。所以本轮
  在时限内启动的线程都登记下来；整轮超时或出错后，先等它们结束（最多 30 s）再落 assistant 消息、释放会话锁和名额——
  否则线程可能在锁释放后还在写 quote。超过 30 s 记 error 日志后照常结束。线程占着名额，因此线程数有上限。
- **app.db 时限**：每条语句等锁最多 10 s（busy timeout），每个连接（一次读或写事务）从打开起 10 s 后中断正在跑的 SQL；
  两者都回滚并抛 `StoreUnavailable`。HTTP 一律 503 `data_unavailable`（出票：没写入任何东西，quote 和 nonce 不变，可重试）；
  对话轮次里走现有的 `internal_error` / 模板回退。
- **每用户上限**：同一用户同时运行的轮次最多 `AGENT_MAX_TURNS_PER_USER`（默认 2，1–256），在会话锁之后、名额之前检查；
  超出 → SSE `error conversation_busy`（文案说明是其他会话在忙），什么都不存，不退额度。
- **出票点击不占线程等锁**：`book_async` 在事件循环上等会话锁（`hold_async`），拿到锁后才在工作线程里跑出票事务；请求被取消时
  也等事务线程结束再释放锁。每用户同时进行的点击最多 2 个，超出 → 409 `conversation_busy`（可重试，什么都没改）。
  出票事务开始前先加载已变化的 locations.db，事务内的 B6 严格复核只需重新哈希文件。
- **线程池大小**：启动时显式设置事件循环默认线程池为 `2 × AGENT_MAX_ACTIVE_TURNS + 16`（默认 32）：每个运行中的轮次
  同时最多用一个线程，被打断的轮次最多两个（未结束的工具线程 + 被打断调用的记录），余量给出票事务和路由的短读取。
- **消息没存上**：保存用户消息时 app.db 出错 → SSE `internal_error`（“没有保存”），在 `user_message` 之前，退还当天额度。
  app.db 超时的 HTTP 503 文案改为 “服务繁忙，没有做任何改动”。
- 未覆盖（替换原句）：读 locations.db 没有操作时限；出票事务里的严格复核仍在 app.db 写锁内哈希 locations.db，文件系统卡住时
  写锁被一直占着，其他写入 10 s 后 `StoreUnavailable`。CPU 计算（路由毫秒级）。等名额时持有会话锁：全站满载时，
  同会话的点击最多等 5 s（在事件循环上，不占线程）后得到 `conversation_busy`。

## 6. 确认与出票（要求 7）

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> quoted: quote_route
  quoted --> presented: 卡片随 done 发给用户
  presented --> booked: 用户点击确认 且 B1–B7 通过
  presented --> expired: 超过 15 分钟
  presented --> stale: 出票复核发现数据变化
  booked --> [*]
  expired --> [*]
  stale --> [*]
```

没有「取代」：同一会话可以同时存在多张有效报价（比较两条航线、往返各一张都正常）。

出票条件（全部满足才出票；编号规则在 `docs/design/state_invariants.md`，用模型测试覆盖）：
- **B1 归属**：quote 属于当前登录用户。
- **B2 已展示**：quote 状态为 `presented`，即带完整航段、中转、距离、价格的卡片已随 `done` 发给用户。
- **B3 用户点击**：请求来自出票接口，携带该卡片签发的一次性 nonce（nonce 绑定 quote、用户、卡片所在消息；用一次即失效）。
  LLM 没有调用出票接口的路径。
- **B4 有效期**：未超过 15 分钟。
- **B5 幂等**：同一 quote 最多一张票（`tickets.quote_id` UNIQUE）。
- **B6 复核**：用当前 locations.db（指纹检查，必要时重载）重算同一城市序列：每段两端城市和坐标与 quote 一致、
  该航段仍存在，规范函数算出的距离和价格与存档字符串相等；起终点的最便宜路线仍是这条。否则 quote → `stale`，
  提示重新报价，用户需重新确认。
- **B7 原子性**：`BEGIN IMMEDIATE` 事务内完成检查、写票、改 quote 状态；聊天和出票接口共用会话锁；uvicorn 单 worker。

如何回答 take-home 的「怎么保证未经确认不出票」：出票只有一个接口，只接受用户点击带来的 nonce，而 nonce 只在
完整路线 / 距离 / 价格的卡片发给用户之后才签发；LLM 能做的只是让这张卡片出现。自然语言里的「好的，订吧」
会让确认卡出现，但不会出票。

## 7. 数据模型（app.db）
## 11. 已知限制与下一步（初稿）

- 无航班日期、时刻、座位、乘客信息、支付、退改签（take-home 未要求；写进「真实上线还需要什么」）。
- 出票需要一次点击：自然语言「订吧」只会弹出确认卡。这是为了让「未经确认不出票」由代码保证，而不是由 LLM 判断。
- ReplyGuard 拦不住用文字写出的数；可能误伤用户提到的其他数字 → 白名单 + 模板回退，回退率在评测里统计。
- 单进程、单 worker、SQLite；并发量有限，demo 足够。
- 航班时刻、座位、库存：接口位置预留在 `airline/`，现在不实现、不编造。
- Bonus（必交物之后）：thinking level 作为用户高级选项（默认 high）；BYOK（用户自带 key，只在浏览器保存、按请求发送，
  服务端不存不记）；默认 key 由网关层限流；用评测框架 bench DeepSeek flash 各 thinking level 的通过率与成本，

### 4.9 并发与阻塞调用（06 P0b，#33）
- **全站并发上限**：同时运行的对话轮次最多 `AGENT_MAX_ACTIVE_TURNS`（默认 8，1–256），在每会话锁之外。先拿会话锁，再拿名额
  （先来先得），最多等 `AGENT_TURN_QUEUE_SECONDS`（默认 5 s，0–60）；等不到 → SSE `error server_busy`，在 `user_message`
  之前发出，什么都不存，并退还当天的消息额度。等待是 `await`，不阻塞事件循环。
- **线程不能强制中止**：工具和 app.db 调用在工作线程里跑（`asyncio.to_thread`）；超时只能停止等待，线程会跑完。所以本轮
  在时限内启动的线程都登记下来；整轮超时或出错后，先等它们结束（最多 30 s）再落 assistant 消息、释放会话锁和名额——
  否则线程可能在锁释放后还在写 quote。超过 30 s 记 error 日志后照常结束。线程占着名额，因此线程数有上限。
- **app.db 时限**：每条语句等锁最多 10 s（busy timeout），每个连接（一次读或写事务）从打开起 10 s 后中断正在跑的 SQL；
  两者都回滚并抛 `StoreUnavailable`。HTTP 一律 503 `data_unavailable`（出票：没写入任何东西，quote 和 nonce 不变，可重试）；
  对话轮次里走现有的 `internal_error` / 模板回退。
- **每用户上限**：同一用户同时运行的轮次最多 `AGENT_MAX_TURNS_PER_USER`（默认 2，1–256），在会话锁之后、名额之前检查；
  超出 → SSE `error conversation_busy`（文案说明是其他会话在忙），什么都不存，不退额度。
- **出票点击不占线程等锁**：`book_async` 在事件循环上等会话锁（`hold_async`），拿到锁后才在工作线程里跑出票事务；请求被取消时
  也等事务线程结束再释放锁。每用户同时进行的点击最多 2 个，超出 → 409 `conversation_busy`（可重试，什么都没改）。
  出票事务开始前先加载已变化的 locations.db，事务内的 B6 严格复核只需重新哈希文件。
- **线程池大小**：启动时显式设置事件循环默认线程池为 `2 × AGENT_MAX_ACTIVE_TURNS + 16`（默认 32）：每个运行中的轮次
  同时最多用一个线程，被打断的轮次最多两个（未结束的工具线程 + 被打断调用的记录），余量给出票事务和路由的短读取。
- **消息没存上**：保存用户消息时 app.db 出错 → SSE `internal_error`（“没有保存”），在 `user_message` 之前，退还当天额度。
  app.db 超时的 HTTP 503 文案改为 “服务繁忙，没有做任何改动”。
- 未覆盖（替换原句）：读 locations.db 没有操作时限；出票事务里的严格复核仍在 app.db 写锁内哈希 locations.db，文件系统卡住时
  写锁被一直占着，其他写入 10 s 后 `StoreUnavailable`。CPU 计算（路由毫秒级）。等名额时持有会话锁：全站满载时，
  同会话的点击最多等 5 s（在事件循环上，不占线程）后得到 `conversation_busy`。

## 6. 确认与出票（要求 7）

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> quoted: quote_route
  quoted --> presented: 卡片随 done 发给用户
  presented --> booked: 用户点击确认 且 B1–B7 通过
  presented --> expired: 超过 15 分钟
  presented --> stale: 出票复核发现数据变化
  booked --> [*]
  expired --> [*]
  stale --> [*]
```

没有「取代」：同一会话可以同时存在多张有效报价（比较两条航线、往返各一张都正常）。

出票条件（全部满足才出票；编号规则在 `docs/design/state_invariants.md`，用模型测试覆盖）：
- **B1 归属**：quote 属于当前登录用户。
- **B2 已展示**：quote 状态为 `presented`，即带完整航段、中转、距离、价格的卡片已随 `done` 发给用户。
- **B3 用户点击**：请求来自出票接口，携带该卡片签发的一次性 nonce（nonce 绑定 quote、用户、卡片所在消息；用一次即失效）。
  LLM 没有调用出票接口的路径。
- **B4 有效期**：未超过 15 分钟。
- **B5 幂等**：同一 quote 最多一张票（`tickets.quote_id` UNIQUE）。
- **B6 复核**：用当前 locations.db（指纹检查，必要时重载）重算同一城市序列：每段两端城市和坐标与 quote 一致、
  该航段仍存在，规范函数算出的距离和价格与存档字符串相等；起终点的最便宜路线仍是这条。否则 quote → `stale`，
  提示重新报价，用户需重新确认。
- **B7 原子性**：`BEGIN IMMEDIATE` 事务内完成检查、写票、改 quote 状态；聊天和出票接口共用会话锁；uvicorn 单 worker。

如何回答 take-home 的「怎么保证未经确认不出票」：出票只有一个接口，只接受用户点击带来的 nonce，而 nonce 只在
完整路线 / 距离 / 价格的卡片发给用户之后才签发；LLM 能做的只是让这张卡片出现。自然语言里的「好的，订吧」
会让确认卡出现，但不会出票。

"""app.db: the business database (users, conversations, messages, call logs, quotes, tickets).

Plain stdlib sqlite3, no ORM. Every operation opens its own connection, so a `Store` can be shared
between threads. Writes run inside `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` (`Store.write()`): the write lock is taken
before the first read, so a check-then-write sequence cannot interleave with another writer.

Times are ISO 8601 UTC strings with second precision (`2026-11-23T08:15:00Z`); sub-seconds are
truncated when a time is stored. The clock is injectable.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import secrets
import sqlite3
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable, Iterator

Clock = Callable[[], datetime]

# Timeouts (06 P0b, design §4.9). Store calls run in worker threads (`asyncio.to_thread`), which
# cannot be killed; these bound how long one store operation can keep its thread busy.
BUSY_TIMEOUT = 10.0  # seconds a statement waits for another connection's lock ("database is locked")
OPERATION_TIMEOUT = 10.0  # wall seconds one connection (= one read / write transaction) may live while SQL runs
_PROGRESS_OPS = 1000  # SQLite VM instructions between two deadline checks

SCHEMA_VERSION = 3

class OpTiming(NamedTuple):
    """One `Store.read()` / `Store.write()`, for the optional timing hook (benchmarks, #41).

    `wait`: seconds spent in `BEGIN` / `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` - for a write, the time spent waiting for
    app.db's single writer lock (SQLite's busy handler). `hold`: seconds from the end of BEGIN to
    the end of COMMIT / ROLLBACK (the writer lock is held for this long). `total`: seconds from
    opening to closing the connection. Times not reached are None. `outcome`: "commit",
    "rollback" (the body raised), "busy" (a lock wait passed busy_timeout), "timeout" (the
    operation deadline interrupted SQL) or "error" (any other failure)."""
    kind: str  # "read" | "write"
    wait: float | None
    hold: float | None
    total: float
    outcome: str


_timing_hook: Callable[[OpTiming], Any] | None = None


def set_timing_hook(hook: Callable[[OpTiming], Any] | None) -> Callable[[OpTiming], Any] | None:
    """Install (or with None remove) a process-wide function called once after every
    `Store.read()` / `Store.write()` with its `OpTiming`; returns the previous hook. Off by default:
    then the only cost is one global lookup per operation. The hook runs in the calling thread
    after the connection is closed; it must be fast and thread-safe. Its exceptions are ignored,
    so it cannot change what the store does."""
    global _timing_hook
    previous, _timing_hook = _timing_hook, hook
    return previous

            locked: float | None, ended: float | None, outcome: str) -> None:

        pass

    return "timeout" if "interrupted" in str(exc).lower() else "busy"

'''

def test_a_write_that_waits_too_long_for_the_lock_is_store_unavailable(tmp_path):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "app.db", busy_timeout=0.1)
    user = store.upsert_user("dev", "u", "U")["id"]
    other = sqlite3.connect(store.path, isolation_level=None)
    other.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
    try:
        started = time.monotonic()
        with pytest.raises(StoreUnavailable):
            store.create_conversation(user)
        assert time.monotonic() - started < 2
        assert isinstance(StoreUnavailable("x"), sqlite3.OperationalError)
    finally:
        other.execute("ROLLBACK")
        other.close()
    assert store.list_conversations(user) == []  # nothing written
    store.create_conversation(user)  # works again

    endless = "WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n) SELECT count(*) FROM n"
    for ctx in (store.write, store.read):
        started = time.monotonic()
        with pytest.raises(StoreUnavailable, match="interrupted"):
            with ctx() as con:

def test_store_timeout_defaults(tmp_path):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "app.db")
    assert (store.busy_timeout, store.operation_timeout) == (10.0, 10.0)
